connector.name: Jaeger MCP
connector.registryDescription: Jaeger MCP - search traces, inspect spans, map service dependencies (read-only).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package jaeger-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mshegolev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: JAEGER_URL
env.description: Jaeger query service URL, e.g. https://jaeger.example.com

env.name: JAEGER_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for authentication. Takes priority over Basic auth.

env.name: JAEGER_USERNAME
env.description: HTTP Basic auth username. Used only when JAEGER_TOKEN is not set.

env.name: JAEGER_SSL_VERIFY
env.description: Verify SSL certificates (true/false). Set to 'false' for self-signed certs.
